backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing the backend for a farm bookkeeping app, handling admin bootstrap registration, user profiles, and an approval system with role-based access control.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting that Dashboard.tsx implements the reverted flat navigation button row (from v15 dropdown back to v14 style), with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of all frontend source files, describing each component's purpose and recent changes.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark color themes including background, foreground, chart, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Pepper Farm Bookkeeping React app, mounting the app into a root div and loading the main TSX module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component orchestrating authentication, bootstrap registration, profile setup, and approval-state routing to render LoginPrompt, WaitingForApprovalScreen, or Dashboard based on user state.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying the current year and a caffeine.ai attribution link with dynamic UTM parameters based on the app's hostname.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: App header showing the farm branding, authenticated user's name, and a login/logout button that clears React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/LoginPrompt.tsx: Landing page for unauthenticated users featuring a hero image and four feature cards highlighting income tracking, inventory, customer management, and the financial dashboard.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog that prompts new users to enter their name before accessing the app, submitting via the useSaveCallerUserProfile mutation.
frontend/src/components/RejectedScreen.t: Displays an 'Access Not Approved' screen for users whose account requests were rejected, with a sign-out button that clears identity and query cache.
frontend/src/components/tabs/AttendanceT: Renders a workers management tab with a list of farm workers and a dialog form to add new workers with name and role fields.
frontend/src/components/tabs/CustomersTa: Displays a searchable customer list with add-customer functionality and a per-customer purchase history dialog showing sales records.
Provides a full CRUD interface for farm expense records with category filtering, search, and add/edit/delete dialogs using Nigerian Naira formatting.
frontend/src/components/tabs/FarmTimeTab: Renders a monthly calendar grid for tracking worker daily attendance, allowing users to click a day to record presence, arrival, and departure times per worker.
frontend/src/components/tabs/IncomeTab.t: React component for displaying and adding farm income records, with search/filter by source, a dialog form for new entries, and Naira-formatted totals.
frontend/src/components/tabs/InventoryTa: React component for managing farm inventory items, supporting add/edit via a dialog form, filtering by item type, and displaying total inventory value.
frontend/src/components/tabs/SalesTab.ts: React component for recording and viewing farm sales transactions, linking customers and inventory items, with search and total revenue calculation.
Dashboard tab that aggregates income, expenses, net profit, inventory value, and low-stock alerts, plus a list of recent transactions, with loading skeletons.
frontend/src/components/tabs/Verificatio: Admin tab for managing user approval requests, allowing approve/reject actions on pending principals and displaying all approval statuses in a table.
frontend/src/components/WaitingForApprov: Shows a pending-approval screen where users can send an approval request and refresh their approval status while waiting for a farm member to grant access.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and AuthClient creation with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend interactions including user profiles, approvals, inventory, sales, income, expenses, customers, workers, and attendance records.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines light/dark mode CSS custom properties for the design system's color tokens.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page with tab-based navigation across Summary, Income, Expenses, Inventory, Customers, Sales, Attendance, Farm Time, and an admin-only Verification tab.
frontend/src/utils/farmTime.ts: Utility functions for the Farm Time calendar feature, including date/nanosecond conversions, month grid generation, time parsing/formatting, and duration formatting.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens (primary, secondary, sidebar, chart, etc.), border radius, accordion keyframes, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata tracking version, features, and requests; records one existing feature to revert Dashboard navigation from a dropdown menu back to a flat button row from version 14.
